gotchas.title: Class action exceptions are legally binding
gotchas.description: Rules referencing class action settlements (CS-4471, 2009-CV-118) are legally binding. Never approve removal without legal sign-off.

discoveredFrom.description: BR-DISC-EXCEPTION shows code implements CS-4471 but spec doesn't mention it

gotchas.title: Legacy pricing grandfathering must be preserved
gotchas.description: Plan-7 customers retain locked-in pricing per 2009 class action. Never remove grandfathering logic.

gotchas.title: Regulation E inbound refund carve-out is legally mandatory
gotchas.description: Per US 12 CFR § 1005 (Regulation E) and Settlement Ticket CB-9102, inbound merchant refunds (RFIN) must never be blocked even on frozen or suspended accounts. Blocking refunds triggers severe statutory consumer banking penalties.

discoveredFrom.description: COBOL code implements Ticket CB-9102 Regulation E carve-out, while outdated spec §2.3 falsely claimed zero exceptions
